_about: The child (Child, scripts/villagers/child.gd; docs/DESIGN.md, ความรักและแต่งงาน -> ลูก). One child per marriage, no gender in the rules. news_after_days: the news comes this many days after the wedding day (flag wedding_day), on the first morning from then that is not a festival day and the spouse's heart band is at least news_band. birth_after_days: the birth comes this many days after the news, on the first morning from then that is not a festival day. stages: by days since the birth, from (a stage runs until the next one starts; the last never ends). hearts: the child's affection under the id child; start_band and min_band are heart bands of Affection.rules().bands, so the child starts at band 3 and never falls below it. look: the child has the spouse's hair style and colour; skin is the middle of the farmer's and the spouse's skin (skin_mix 0.5); clothes are the small indigo happi every child wears. names: three for each spouse, all gender-neutral, made up for this game; the player picks one at the birth. Balance numbers are ours.

cradle._about: The baby's bamboo cradle in the second room (a cradle prop in data/maps/house.json, shown while the stage is baby: the flag child_stage). times: from (HH:MM) until the next row's from, the last running past midnight to the first; look is the picture (asleep, awake, cry) and line what the farmer reads looking in (%s is the child's name). The house's clock stands still indoors, so it is the hour the farmer came in.

times.line: %s is fast asleep, breathing slow and even.
%s is awake before the birds and crying to be fed.
%s is wide awake, waving two small fists at the beams.
%s is napping, one hand curled by one cheek.
%s is awake and kicking at the quilt.
%s watches the lantern light and yawns.

figures._about: How the crawler, the toddler and the child are drawn (Child.figure_key, FigureArt.draw_little): build is the FigureArt body (crawler on hands and knees, toddler and child standing); stride is the cells moved per walk frame (short arms and legs take short steps). styles: the spouse's hair style as the little one wears it (no long hair, headbands, tenugui or straw hats on someone this small: long hair is tied up in a bun).

days._about: Where the crawler and the toddler are through the day (Child.plan, shown by Villagers like a villager): per stage a speed (cells per game minute), rules ({if: the conditions of a villager rule, plan}: the first that holds picks the day's plan, else default) and plans in the villager plan format (DayPlan; README.md, Villagers). by_spouse: while the plan and the spouse are both on map `home`, the little one stays at the spouse's side, this many cells off the spouse, turned to them (the crawler on the mat in front of them, the toddler beside them at the kotatsu). A stage with no plans of its own (the child, until step 5 gives it some) uses the toddler's. Ours: the crawler never leaves the house; the toddler plays in the yard by the dog's kennel from 9:00 to 15:45 on dry days and stays in on wet days and festival days; both are in bed from 20:00.

gifts._about: What the little one thinks of a gift (Villagers.reaction, as a villager's gifts): sweets and wild berries are the best, bitter and hot things the worst. Gifts are taken from the stage gifts_from on (the crawler only babbles). Ours.
